verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a collaboration platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no documented capability to act on many items at once, such as batch requests, bulk edit, move, or delete, or mass member management. The Graph automation material (creating teams, adding people, posting messages) describes per-item primitives a developer could use to build bulk workflows. The Export APIs belong to the separate data-export story, so neither earns credit here.
